scope: Prospective family-specific development-training-A numerical diagnosis, conditional fixed optimizer amendment and scientific continuation only after gates

numerical_checks.synthetic: Every coordinate at all three seed initializations for every family/size/ridge on a fixed 2-trial, 4-bin, 2-unit fixture; independent scalar forward/recurrence and exhaustive state enumeration
numerical_checks.real: All 216 training-only original-budget replays. Finite differences at initial and terminal vectors on 12 fixed SHA-seeded coordinates plus first/last coordinate; all seeds/configurations/regions mandatory
numerical_checks.penalty: All dynamical coefficients penalized; negative full log-likelihood divided by trial-times-bin exposure, not unit-bin count; unchanged frozen definitions
numerical_checks.projection: Bounds [-8,8]; zero outward descent at active lower/upper bounds, retain inward descent
numerical_checks.conditioning: Training-only context/history ranges and singular values, initial and terminal gradients, objective and accepted-iteration histories, bound hits; no validation scores

conditional_amendment.requires: All independent checks PASS and original replay supports premature relative-objective stopping. Must be independently registered before new fits

first_mouse_gate: All 216 attempts retained. Require at least one unchanged all-seed/both-region eligible configuration per family before full cohort; failures never pruned or treated as converged
custody: Existing isolated zero-capability native analysis AppContainer. Training A only for diagnosis and amendment smoke; existing frozen offsets reused without fitting. B permitted only after registered training-only numerical gate PASS for unchanged scientific competition. Final mice/evaluation always inaccessible
stop_conditions: Mathematical implementation defect: STOP, separate authorization required
Any mandatory independent numerical check fails: STOP
Amended first-mouse numerical gate fails: STOP NUMERICAL_INCONCLUSIVE, no further automatic optimizer changes
Any isolation/leakage or subsequent scientific gate fails: STOP
reproduction: Saved-results replay and synthetic numerical checks; not claimed to reproduce unexecuted fits, null tests or final evaluation
